incidents.title: Customer database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.description: Customer Service experienced intermittent database connection failures shortly after deployment 2.4.1. Pool utilization reached its configured maximum and request latency increased.
incidents.resolution_summary: Mitigated by rolling back the connection pool configuration and restarting Customer Service.
incidents.investigation_notes: Customer Database connections rose sharply after the deployment. The timing is suggestive but does not alone prove causation.

incidents.title: Payment API elevated timeout rate
incidents.description: Payment API timeout rate increased while calls to Customer Service were slow. Payment authorization latency exceeded the service objective.
incidents.resolution_summary: Traffic recovered after Customer Service stabilized.
incidents.investigation_notes: Correlates in time with INC-101; likely downstream dependency impact.

incidents.title: Notification consumer lag
incidents.description: Notification Service fell behind on payment-events. Consumer lag increased during a high-volume notification period.
incidents.resolution_summary: Consumer concurrency was increased and backlog drained.
incidents.investigation_notes: Investigate consumer capacity and event burst size.

incidents.title: Fraud database deadlocks
incidents.description: Fraud Service experienced transaction deadlocks while updating risk review records.
incidents.resolution_summary: A database index and transaction ordering change reduced contention.
incidents.investigation_notes: No evidence linking this incident to payment database pool exhaustion.

incidents.title: Order creation failures during inventory reservation
incidents.description: Order creation failed when Inventory Service reservation calls exceeded their timeout.
incidents.resolution_summary: Inventory query latency was reduced and retry limits were adjusted.
incidents.investigation_notes: The failure propagated from an inventory dependency to Order Service.

incidents.title: Settlement batch processing delay
incidents.description: Settlement batches took longer than usual due to slow database queries.
incidents.resolution_summary: Query plan was corrected and batch processing recovered.
incidents.investigation_notes: May affect Reporting Service freshness through settlement data.

incidents.title: Reporting data freshness degradation
incidents.description: Reporting data was delayed because settlement events were arriving late.
incidents.resolution_summary: Reporting caught up after upstream settlement processing recovered.
incidents.investigation_notes: Potentially related to settlement pipeline, not necessarily a Reporting defect.

incidents.title: Inventory database query latency
incidents.description: Inventory reservation queries showed elevated latency after a traffic increase.
incidents.resolution_summary: Query tuning and connection monitoring reduced latency.
incidents.investigation_notes: Inventory latency can affect Order Service because it depends on Inventory Service.

incidents.title: Authentication profile lookup latency
incidents.description: Authentication requests slowed when profile lookups to Customer Service became delayed.
incidents.resolution_summary: Customer lookup caching reduced the impact.
incidents.investigation_notes: Authentication Service depends on Customer Service.

incidents.title: Audit event backlog
incidents.description: Audit Service lagged while consuming payment and order events.
incidents.resolution_summary: Consumer throughput was increased.
incidents.investigation_notes: Shared event topics can affect more than one consumer.

incidents.title: Customer profile read latency
incidents.description: Customer profile reads slowed after a query pattern change.
incidents.resolution_summary: A missing index was added.
incidents.investigation_notes: Historical Customer Service database latency incident.

incidents.title: Payment retry storm
incidents.description: Payment retries amplified load during a downstream timeout event.
incidents.resolution_summary: Retry backoff and jitter were adjusted.
incidents.investigation_notes: Retries can amplify an underlying dependency issue.

incidents.title: Fraud decision cache inconsistency
incidents.description: Fraud decisions briefly used stale cached rule data.
incidents.resolution_summary: Cache invalidation was corrected.
incidents.investigation_notes: Risk decision inconsistency; separate from Customer Database incidents.

incidents.title: Order event schema incompatibility
incidents.description: Inventory Service rejected a subset of order events after a schema change.
incidents.resolution_summary: Producer and consumer schema versions were aligned.
incidents.investigation_notes: Demonstrates event-contract failure across service boundaries.

incidents.title: Settlement retry queue buildup
incidents.description: Settlement retry queue grew while database operations were slow.
incidents.resolution_summary: Retry schedule was tuned.
incidents.investigation_notes: Potentially related to settlement database contention.

incidents.title: Notification duplicate messages
incidents.description: Some notifications were delivered more than once during consumer rebalancing.
incidents.resolution_summary: Idempotency checks were strengthened.
incidents.investigation_notes: Operational issue in event consumption.

incidents.title: Inventory reservation timeout
incidents.description: Inventory reservation requests timed out during a traffic peak.
incidents.resolution_summary: Query and connection usage were tuned.
incidents.investigation_notes: Can propagate to Order Service.

incidents.title: Reporting query saturation
incidents.description: Large reporting queries consumed database resources and delayed report generation.
incidents.resolution_summary: Query limits and scheduling were adjusted.
incidents.investigation_notes: Shares Settlement Database with other data workloads.

incidents.title: Authentication token validation errors
incidents.description: A token validation change caused intermittent authentication failures.
incidents.resolution_summary: Configuration was corrected.
incidents.investigation_notes: Authentication-specific failure.

incidents.title: Audit database write latency
incidents.description: Audit writes slowed during a high-volume event period.
incidents.resolution_summary: Write batching was tuned.
incidents.investigation_notes: Audit workload shares Settlement Database with reporting and settlement workloads.
